import websocket, json, time, sys, os

# Disable proxy for localhost
for v in ['HTTP_PROXY','HTTPS_PROXY','http_proxy','https_proxy']:
    os.environ.pop(v, None)

import urllib.request
data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:1337/json/list").read())
page = next(t for t in data if t.get('type')=='page')
ws_url = page['webSocketDebuggerUrl']
print("WS:", ws_url)

ws = websocket.create_connection(ws_url)
msg_id = 0

def send(method, params=None, expect_id=True):
    global msg_id
    msg_id += 1
    cur_id = msg_id
    ws.send(json.dumps({"id": cur_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
    while True:
        msg = json.loads(ws.recv())
        if msg.get("id") == cur_id:
            return msg

send("Page.enable")
send("Runtime.enable")

print("navigating to chrome://settings/search...")
send("Page.navigate", {"url": "chrome://settings/search"})

# Wait for load
time.sleep(3)

# Inspect what we got
res = send("Runtime.evaluate", {
    "expression": "({title: document.title, url: location.href, body: document.body ? document.body.innerHTML.length : 0})",
    "returnByValue": True
})
print("page state:", res.get("result", {}).get("result", {}).get("value"))

ws.close()
PYEOF
